detail.longDescription: just joined this new team about 1 year into their development. Demoed the work to the team about two weeks ago (half way in). Work is practically complete & runs well no issues. I create PR & assign the two PR reviewers (one my rank another a rank above me). one colleague (the one at my level) leaves some constructive comments no functional changes. The other colleague (one rank above me) says something equivalent to "does not meet our standards" "do not do x pattern since we have used y (which has a huge limitation)" to use Y pattern I would basically need to change most of the logic and it would be about 70% waste. I demoed my code with this pattern two weeks ago and there were no issues/comments from the team. The code is concise and easy to read. I had a call with the colleague and explained the code and why I used it, and showed him some other parts of the codebase where this pattern should be used, his only defense was that "it does not meet our standards because it uses X rather than y pattern, since we used y pattern in the past, we should only use y pattern" while x pattern is very similar only removing the limitation that was causing the code to be difficult to maintain etc. This "standard requirement" is written nowhere as a hard requirement and the codebase is barely one year old, with only one of the codebase founders still on the team.... I'm going to have a chat with the manager tomorrow morning.
